headline: Consistent Nexus typography and accessible mobile controls

changes.title: Apply the approved typography system
changes.detail: Use DM Sans for UI and explanatory copy, retain Fraunces for editorial headings, and use DM Mono selectively for technical numbers.
changes.screen: Today / Calendar / Stash / Plans / Learn / More

changes.title: Improve control sizing and accessible names
changes.detail: Restore at least 44px targets for identified calendar, header, secondary and back actions; add contextual accessible labels while preserving existing layouts.
changes.screen: Calendar / Today / App Updates / Shared controls

changes.title: Clarify Supplies typography
changes.detail: Distinguish technical quantities from supporting labels and explanations without altering supply calculations or inventory.

changes.title: Expand layout and typography regression evidence
changes.detail: Add browser-computed font role and touch target checks across 320px and 390px, dark and light, without changing user records.

dataImpact: No migration, destructive write, inventory mutation, dose calculation change, or saved-data rewrite. PR132 introduces scoped presentational typography and accessibility improvements plus QA tests only; keep existing localStorage, backups and history untouched.
limitations: Physical iPhone Safari, downloaded web-font rendering, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver acceptance are still pending.
Post-merge release-artifact gate failed against stale prior release metadata; this proposed manifest correction is unmerged and its full CI has not yet passed.
